3240-5256-6462-8347.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

6753-7824-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Exalted Sunborn and Bard.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
6753-7824-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

465-803-3742-4251-5434.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3490-4050-4716-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4716-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4002-4331-4993-7356.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-7356.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1477-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
1477-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1477-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

225-573-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-573-5702-6850.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-573-5702-6850.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {R}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

3705-4050-4871-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

1477-2173-3652-5220.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1062-3484-4444-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3484-4444-5674.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-4359.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-4359.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

654-678-2921-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

855-1495-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
855-1495-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4050-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4050-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

224-3756-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

407-2400-3887.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten Swamps.
407-2400-3887.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {B} for each Swamp you control.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Onyx Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Cabal Coffers.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Repeat.

560-2835-4050-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-4050-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding two mana of any color.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.

6-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-5803.description:
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Vitalize.
Resolve the copy of Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

186-4131-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 4/4 Construct with haste named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mishra's Warform's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2239-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Ardent Elementalist
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Ardent Elementalist
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

643-647-3259-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
643-647-3259-4302.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-2083-4659-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C}.
Wood Sage does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2083-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature on top of your library.
Activate Wood Sage by tapping it, naming the creature put on top of your library, then revealing the top four cards of your library and putting the creature into your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If the artifact creature can be cast using {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

330-4231-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
330-4231-4508.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, a Food, and a Clue token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

579-1562-4824.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
